title: He Found A Notebook That Kills: Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: A mysterious black notebook drops from the sky onto the school courtyard. The student, Light, walks over, picks it up, and examines the ominous white lettering on the cover: Death Note. He flips open the first page to read its chilling rules. The human whose name is written in this note shall die. Light chuckles at what feels like a ridiculous chain-letter prank. Yet an unsettling curiosity takes hold, and he decides to take the notebook home.

Back inside his bedroom, Light studies the notebook's horrifying instructions in complete secrecy. To take effect, the writer must hold the victim's face in mind, ensuring people with the same name are spared. If the cause of death is not specified within forty seconds, the victim simply dies of a sudden heart attack. Writing specific details grants an additional six minutes and forty seconds. The cold logic of the rules rattles him. He hesitates, deeply aware that testing this cursed book could turn him into a murderer.

Soon after, a breaking news bulletin interrupts the broadcast with an urgent crisis at a daycare. An armed criminal named Kuro Otoharada has taken children and teachers hostage inside. Light stares at the television screen with rising tension. This is his chance to test the notebook on someone truly deserving of punishment. He grips his pen and writes Otoharada's name across the blank page. He glances down at his watch as the forty-second countdown begins.

As the final seconds slip away, the daycare doors unexpectedly swing open. The terrified hostages walk out into the sunlight completely unharmed. The news anchor breaks in with breathless updates from the scene. Special forces have breached the building and found the hostage-taker collapsed on the floor. Police confirm no weapons were discharged. The criminal suffered a sudden, fatal heart attack inside the classroom. Light stares at the television in frozen disbelief. A wave of dread washes over him as he realizes the impossible power of the notebook might actually be real.

Desperate to prove the first death was nothing more than an improbable coincidence, Light seeks a second test. Outside a convenience store, he watches an aggressive street biker named Taku Shibuimaru harass a young woman. Light quietly steps inside the shop, opens the Death Note, and writes Taku's name, specifying death by accidental traffic collision. Moments later, Taku revs his engine and speeds recklessly into the street. An oncoming freight truck swerves and violently slams into the motorcycle, sending debris flying across the asphalt. Taku lies motionless on the pavement. Light recoils in sheer terror. The notebook is undeniably real. He has crossed the point of no return by taking two human lives, but an unseen supernatural watcher is already closing in.

series.summary: Light discovers the Death Note and tests its lethal power on a hostage-taker and an aggressive biker, confirming with horror that the notebook's curse is real.
